ambiguities: Spec says 'ne = 1 always' so neutral-site is never used; h identified with I=1 on home obs only.
Games with ties in ordering sorted by (date string, game_id); date compared lexicographically as ISO strings.
'First kept' for duplicate game ids taken in directory order MLB2022..MLB2026 then sorted filename; duplicates removed before filtering order.
Starter unavailable: missing pitchers list/empty, pid not in players, pit null, or any of outs/bf/np null -> all starter values missing for both sides.
Kernel x missing => own value missing; reference rows require all x and v present; MIN_REF=500 for every kernel (no conditions used).
Kernel NaN when sum k_i is 0 (underflow) literally; no log-sum-exp stabilisation.
Ridge uses all teams in Games as parameters even if absent from the pool (penalty makes them 0).
Pool = all games with date strictly before d and season >= S-1 (S = max season among games on d); ridge for a target missing if <16 kept games.
Starter-target 'offence' for home side is the home team; ep_outs/bf/np use that.
walkoff defined from totals over all inning entries with last entry's home runs; n_inn counts entries including any with missing sides.
